question.worked_solution:
First, we recall the following formula:

$$
{x}^{2}+2ax+{a}^{2}=(x+a)^{2}
$$

Notice that we have a perfect square in the parentheses that we can factor as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+18x+81 & = \\ {x}^{2}+2\cdot 9x+{9}^{2} & = \\ (x+9)^{2} & \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}({x}^{2}+18x+81)+5 & = \\ (x+9)^{2}+5 & .\end{aligned}
$$
